findings.title: Video dataset quality improved after cleaning
findings.statement: The video quality score increased from 61.6 out of 100 to 97.8 out of 100 after removing 7 videos out of 30.
findings.recommendation: Proceed with training using the cleaned dataset of 23 videos.

findings.title: Corrupt and unusable videos removed
findings.statement: Initial quality assessment found 1 corrupt video, 1 too-short clip, 1 black frame video, and 1 frozen video which were removed during cleaning.
findings.recommendation: Ensure data collection pipelines filter out corrupted, static, or extremely short video files before dataset ingestion.

findings.title: Exact and near-duplicates present in raw data
findings.statement: The raw dataset contained 1 group of byte-identical files and 3 groups of near-duplicates that were successfully dropped to prevent data leakage.
findings.recommendation: Maintain duplicate detection checks in preprocessing pipelines for future data additions.

findings.title: Class balance remains consistent
findings.statement: Class distribution across 3 classes maintains an imbalance ratio of 1.5 with 23 clean videos remaining.
findings.recommendation: Consider data augmentation or class weighting to account for the slight class distribution imbalance during training.

findings.title: Silent audio track detected
findings.statement: 1 audio track was found to be silent in the dataset across fractals/fractal_04.mp4.
findings.recommendation: Verify whether audio features are necessary for the classifier; if so, remove or repair the silent audio clip.

findings.title: Suspected mislabeled samples identified
findings.statement: Vision review flagged a total of 2 suspected mislabeled samples as AI model observations that require manual verification.
findings.recommendation: Manually inspect fractals/fractal_09.mp4 and patterns/pattern_09.mp4 to correct potential label errors.

findings.title: Speech content and scene timing characteristics
findings.statement: Across 48 total scenes, 38 scenes contain speech spanning 27 videos with a median scene length of 2.53 seconds.
findings.recommendation: Account for spoken audio overlays matching specific visual scene intervals if training a multimodal model.

narrative.headline: Video dataset quality improved to 97.8 out of 100 after cleaning 30 videos down to 23.
narrative.executive_summary: The pattern_clips.zip dataset quality score increased from 61.6 out of 100 to 97.8 out of 100 after removing 7 videos out of 30. Cleaning removed 1 corrupt video, 1 too-short clip, 1 black frame video, and 1 frozen video, alongside byte-identical and near-duplicate files. The remaining 23 clean videos maintain a class imbalance ratio of 1.5 across 3 classes, with 38 scenes containing speech spanning 27 videos and a median scene length of 2.53 seconds across 48 total scenes. Two suspected mislabeled samples and 1 silent audio track in fractals/fractal_04.mp4 were also identified.
next_steps: Manually verify the 2 suspected mislabeled samples flagged by vision review.
Inspect the silent audio track in fractals/fractal_04.mp4.
Proceed with training the video classifier using the 23 clean videos.
